name: project-plugin-scope-leak
title: Fix project plugin scope leaking into other projects
description: Investigate and fix a plugin isolation bug where project-level plugins from one repo can affect sessions opened in unrelated projects. Repro observed with opencode repo local plugin files triggering math-check command attempts inside a pyope session.
creator: codex
notes: Observed bug: a pyope session titled 'qp函数实现与正规乘积注释' emitted session.error with message 'Command not found: "math-check"', even though math-check exists only under opencode repo project plugins. Root suspicion: project-level plugin discovery or plugin cache is not correctly scoped per active project/worktree/session. Confirm whether plugin hooks are loaded globally once and then reused across unrelated directories, or whether Quick Assistant / bootstrap paths merge config from the wrong root.
